violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the warewashing area was lacking paper towels. Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the warewashing area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Raw animal foods such as raw beef were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as cooked chicken and coleslaw in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

Fried Chicken was observed held at 101 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed and placed to be cooled. Unit was adjusted and ambient of unit reached 144 degrees Fahrenheit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

The condenser in the walk-in cooler was observed with chipped paint. Non FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/18/2026

Several ceiling tiles in the restroom and warewashing area was observed in poor repair (water damage). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Ceiling tiles are also covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Approved Finish Schedule provided during time of inspection. https://datahealth.ri.gov/publications/requirements/FoodProtectionAppovedFinishSchedule.pdf Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2025

The areas around 3 bay sink and grease trap as well as the areas underneath and surrounding equipment has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 12/02/2026

Fried Chicken was observed held at 130 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Fried Chicken was reheated to 189 degrees Fahrenheit during time of inspection. Unit was also adjusted to a higher temperature. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: 1. speed rack and plastic covering in walk-in cooler 2. fanguards in walk-in cooler 3. walls in walk-in cooler New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2025
The condensate from the walk-in cooler unit is draining into the handsink. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain in a proper manner. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2025
Several ceiling tiles in the restroom and warewashing area was observed in poor repair (water damage). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Owner must reinstate FMC license with RIDOH. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2024

The condensate from the chest freezer refrigeration unit was observed with an excess of ice build up. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. Corrective Action - establishment must defrost freezer. New Violation. Correct By: 04/22/2024
